trigger: high-level customer goal (not a one-line fix)

roles.label: CX Designer
roles.job: Work backwards from why a kid or parent would use this today. Design the quietest path. Apple/Dyson: one job on screen, no chrome for its own sake.

roles.label: Experience Composer
roles.job: Use-It Law: every new unit must appear in an existing customer journey this slice. Do not ship a shelf of unused types.

roles.label: Platform Architect
roles.job: Bounded component or item pack. Register, list, render, grade through the kernel. No shell if (id === …). Reuse across catalogs (passages, later math, puzzles).

roles.label: NFR Engineer
roles.job: Local-only memory, i18n-ready strings (copy is data), reliability, a11y, no UA forks, speech reads visible DOM.

roles.label: Builder
roles.job: Implements after the contract is active. Mandatory CX story + journey step + tests.

roles.label: Evaluator
roles.job: Fresh context. Never the Builder. Grades evidence against this roster and the outcome contract.
